contexts.text: To prevent the spermatic vessels ... from carrying off all the purer blood. SE 968.
Therefore the spermatic vessels descend from the emulgents.

This (anxiety) is represented in the renal capsules, when what is prolific and good is carried off from the blood by the spermatic vessels; for, after too much despoiling of it by the spermatic vessels, sadness is wont to supervene, the cause of which may be traced to the fact that the better blood is then deficient in the mass of blood which is carried to the heart.
The Spirits who constitute the province of the spermatic vessels. Explained.
